neighbours.label: The words 'line' and 'lines' in geometry and algebra (two lines, a straight line, line segment), and Russian 'прямой/прямая' (straight)
fire: Is there a formula to tell if two lines, given by point coordinates, cross each other?
A Euclidean vector is frequently represented by a line segment with a definite direction.
Find the equation of the straight line passing through the points A and B on the graph.
The two lines are parallel when their slopes are equal and they never meet.
По каждому проводнику витой пары проходит один и тот же прямой и инвертированный сигнал.
Draw a line through the origin and mark where it crosses the second axis.
Три прямые пересекаются в одной точке, если выполняется это условие.
The line of best fit is chosen so that the sum of the squared errors is smallest.
quiet: Is there a formula to tell if two circles, given by centre and radius, cross each other?
A Euclidean vector is frequently represented by an arrow with a definite direction.
Find the equation of the circle passing through the points A and B on the graph.
The two curves are tangent when their slopes are equal and they touch at one point.
По каждому проводнику витой пары проходит один и тот же сигнал с одинаковой частотой.
Draw a triangle on the origin and mark where it touches the second axis.
Три окружности пересекаются в одной точке, если выполняется это условие.
The best fit is chosen so that the sum of the squared errors is smallest.
